_about: Tree canopy per community area (engine/fetch_canopy.py in fetch-canopy.yml, then engine/canopy.py in run.sh), from ESA WorldCover 2021 (10 m, CC BY 4.0): tree cells over land cells, water left out. Its citywide 15.5% is close to the 16% the Chicago Region Trees Initiative reports. 'cuts' split the lens into four bands.
